draft.title: Spread of pandemics
card: A pandemic is a disease that spreads across many countries and continents. Disease travels with people, so more movement between places means faster spread.
Air travel can carry an infected person between continents in a day or less. The person may not show signs of illness until after they arrive.
Busy trade routes and large numbers of travellers also move disease. Well-connected cities, such as major airport hubs, are often reached first.
COVID-19 was first reported in Wuhan, China, in late 2019. By March 2020 it had reached every inhabited continent and was declared a pandemic.
draft.remember: More links between places means diseases spread faster, reaching well-connected cities first.

a.q: Why can a disease now spread between continents in days rather than months?
opts: Air travel moves people between continents very quickly
Diseases now grow faster than they did in the past
Cities have become much larger than before
Countries have stopped sharing information about disease
a.why: People carry disease with them, and air travel moves people across the world in hours. The size of cities matters less here than the speed and number of links between them.
a.clue: Think about how quickly a person can now cross an ocean.

b.q: A new disease appears in a small farming village far from any airport. Which place is likely to see cases first, after the village?
opts: A major airport city that many travellers pass through
A remote island with only one boat visit a month
A small town that has no roads to other places
A desert settlement with a few visitors each year
b.why: Diseases reach places that are well connected by travel, so a busy airport city is likely to be reached first. The remote places have few links, so people carry the disease to them slowly. Being close on a map matters less than being connected.
b.clue: Which place has the most travellers coming and going?

a.best: Air travel moves people between continents very quickly

b.best: A major airport city that many travellers pass through
